MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 20
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 4

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

5. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 16

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 13

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
